title: Lennar Unveils The Farm, a New Community Rooted in the Inland Empire's Outdoor Lifestyle
body_markdown:
JURUPA VALLEY, Calif.


, Sept. 15, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, announces the debut of The Farm, a new resort-style community in Jurupa Valley, Calif., offering a diverse collection of low-maintenance condominiums and spacious single-family homes. With 16 thoughtfully designed floorplans to choose from, The Farm offers homebuyers a variety of options to suit their lifestyles.


"The Farm is about creating a neighborhood where life extends beyond the walls of the home," said Mark Torres, Lennar Inland Division President. "You can start your morning by walking through the community, spend the afternoon at the pool, meet friends for pickleball or a barbecue and come home to a space designed for the way you live. With a wide range of design options, we've created a community where buyers at many different stages of life can find their place."


Life at The Farm is designed around the simple pleasure of living outdoors and connecting with neighbors. Here, community is woven into the rhythm of everyday life—from afternoons spent poolside and evenings filled with pickleball or backyard barbecues to weekends exploring the parks, playgrounds and community garden. A thoughtfully designed clubhouse and dedicated dog park add even more opportunities to gather, relax and connect, creating a neighborhood where time together comes naturally.


Surrounding these shared spaces are four distinct home collections offering 16 condo and single-family home designs, giving buyers the flexibility to choose a home that fits their stage of life. Homes range from 845 to 2,869 square feet with one to four bedrooms and one-and-one-half to three-and-one-half baths, with pricing starting in the high $400,000s.


Every home at The Farm offers Lennar's signature[Everything's Included®](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774877-1&h=1944339508&u=https%3A%2F%2Fc212.net%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4083698-1%26h%3D1485268572%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lennar.com%252Fproductsandservices%252Feverythings-included%26a%3DEverything%2527s%2BIncluded%25C2%25AE&a=Everything%27s+Included%C2%AE) program, where the homebuilder's most popular features and finishes are built into the base price of the home. At The Farm, this includes stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, hard-surface flooring, cabinetry, and a host of other carefully curated interior touches and designer fixtures.


The Farm provides easy access to shopping, dining and entertainment just minutes away at Eastvale Gateway, The Station at Eastvale and Vernola Marketplace. Proximity to Interstate 15, SR-60 and SR-91 keeps commutes and weekend trips convenient.


For more information on these new home opportunities, call (855) 647-4939 or visit[the community's website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774877-1&h=1230645532&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fcalifornia%2Finland-empire%2Fjurupa-valley%2Fthe-farm&a=the+community%27s+website) .


**About Lennar Corporation**


Lennar Corporation, founded in 1954, is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making the American dream of homeownership attainable for more people. Since its founding, Lennar has built more than 1.5 million homes for buyers at every stage of life in communities across the country, from first-time and move-up buyers to active adults. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments, shaping the future of homebuilding. For more information, visit[www.lennar.com.](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4774877-1&h=533489961&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2F&a=www.lennar.com.)
